plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Fix playback stopping when a track is unavailable (embedding disabled, geo-restricted etc). Previously the proxy returned HTTP 200 with 0 bytes causing LMS to stall. Now closes the connection cleanly so LMS can skip to the next track.
plugin.creator: schmij97
